## DPStyleARWebLive.updateItem() method

Apply the renderer's latest item output to StyleAR. Call this after rendering/updating the virtual item so the current item result is synchronized with the internal StyleAR pipeline.

**Signature:**

```typescript
updateItem(): Promise<void>;
```
**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

A promise that resolves when the item update has been applied.
